title: AC Triage — Output Schema
description: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the output object returned by the ac-triage agent. Defines the routing decision produced by Stage 0 of the /create-ac workflow.

route.description: Routing decision: strategic = new capability; behavioral = add to existing feature; technical = add constraint; covered = already covered.

existing_acs.description: AC IDs that are semantically relevant to the user's request. Empty array for strategic route.

parent_l1_id.description: The ID of the matched L1 AC for behavioral route; null for all other routes.

rationale.description: One-sentence explanation of the classification decision (≤ 80 characters).
